versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the mp4-to-gif skill.
- Provides two-pass, palette-based MP4 to GIF conversion using ffmpeg for high-quality results.
- Includes scripts for Windows (PowerShell) and Linux/macOS (Bash) with customizable parameters.
- Offers detailed guidance on quality/size tradeoffs and optimal settings.
- Highlights common mistakes and best practices for video-to-GIF conversion.
